Package index

Posterior summaries

The posterior distribution of the diagnostics given the site estimates and their standard errors, and what can be read from it. Proper SD priors and mean models with covariates are experimental extensions.

reliability_posterior() format(<reliability_posterior>) print(<reliability_posterior>) summary(<reliability_posterior>) format(<summary.reliability_posterior>) print(<summary.reliability_posterior>) update(<reliability_posterior>) as.data.frame(<reliability_posterior>)
Posterior summaries of the reliability profile
sd_prior()
Prior distribution of the between-site standard deviation
posterior_control()
Settings of the posterior computation
profile_summary()
Summaries of a profile as a data frame
site_table()
Site table of a profile
prob_above()
Posterior probability that a diagnostic exceeds a value
plugin_gap()
Posterior means against plug-in values
functional_density()
Posterior density of a diagnostic
profile_draws()
Draws from the posterior
check_numerics()
Numerical checks of a posterior fit

Profiles at a fixed between-site SD

The reliability profile when the between-site standard deviation is given, for example from a REML fit or a planning value.

reliability_profile() update(<reliability_profile>) format(<reliability_profile>) print(<reliability_profile>) summary(<reliability_profile>) format(<summary.reliability_profile>) print(<summary.reliability_profile>) as.data.frame(<reliability_profile>)
Reliability profile at a fixed between-site SD

Fits from other packages

Diagnostics from posterior draws, from a confidence interval for the between-site variance, and from fits of metafor, ebnm and multisiteDGP. External-draw summaries and confidence-interval mapping are experimental extensions whose interfaces may change in a later 0.x release.

reliability_draws()
Diagnostics from posterior draws of the between-site SD
map_tau2_interval()
Confidence interval for the between-site variance mapped through the diagnostics
reliability_profile(<rma.uni>) reliability_profile(<rma>)
Profiles and posteriors of metafor fits
reliability_profile(<ebnm>)
Profiles of ebnm fits with a normal prior
reliability_profile(<multisitedgp_data>)
Profiles and posteriors of simulated multisite data

Planning

Diagnostics of a profile

The informativeness, the mean reliability, the dispersion and the concentration count of a set of site reliabilities, and the quantities related to them.

typical_variance()

Bregman centroids and dispersions of a reliability profile
